records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended June 30, 2024, revenue was approximately $402.0 million, compared to $325.9 million for the three months ended June 30, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: European revenues for the three months ended June 30, 2024 were $16.7 million, compared to $11.9 million for the three months ended June 30, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This growth was primarily driven by increased revenues from North America, which experienced continued gains in distribution points, shelf space, and SKUs per location, offset in part by a reduction in days on hand inventory by our largest distributor.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended June 30, 2024, selling, general and administrative ("SG&A") expenses totaled approximately $114.9 million, up 22% or $20.7 million from $94.2 million for the second quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash flows provided by operating activities totaled approximately $174.3 million for the six months ended June 30, 2024, which compares to $45.2 million of cash provided by operating activities for the six months ended June 30, 2023.
